info.name: TicketNow - Current APIs + Keycloak
info.description: All 31 current Event & Seat Inventory Service operations through Gateway, interactive Keycloak PKCE, security checks, refresh/logout and optional admin account provisioning. Import the companion environment and read README.md. No public self-registration API exists; registrationAllowed is false. No live operations were run when generating this file.

item.name: 00 - Login (interactive PKCE)
item.description: Run discovery, then get 3 separate tokens. Do not use password grant for ticketnow-postman.

request.description: Authorization > Get New Access Token > login admin01 > Use Token > Send. Copy the access token into environment admin_access_token if it is not saved automatically. This is interactive login, not an automated Runner step.

Authorization > Get New Access Token > login organizer01 > Use Token > Send. Copy the access token into environment organizer_access_token if it is not saved automatically. This is interactive login, not an automated Runner step.

Authorization > Get New Access Token > login customer01 > Use Token > Send. Copy the access token into environment customer_access_token if it is not saved automatically. This is interactive login, not an automated Runner step.

item.name: 08 - Registration (optional admin provisioning)
item.description: Self-registration is currently DISABLED (registrationAllowed=false); there is no /api/v1/auth/register. Set enable_admin_registration=true explicitly, fill local admin credentials and new user fields, then send 01-05 in order. Newly created users log in through the PKCE helper with their own credentials.
